materials_exhausted.note: Local supplementary landing assets were inspected as HTML/figure landing pages and did not contain additional structured activity tables; XML Table 1 and PDF text are the authoritative assay sources.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP/CAMP/APD rows were re-opened and reconciled to XML Table 1, article metadata, and merged sequence rows. Activity values are preserved with primary locators; full-sequence/context gaps remain source_conflict cautions rather than source_verified claims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered 28 MIC rows from primary XML Table 1 across buffer conditions with µM units, organism/strain labels, assay conditions, and locators. Dash cells are retained as nonnumeric table cells, not fabricated activity rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 limited mechanism claims to source-supported potassium dependence, DiSC3-5 membrane-potential dissipation, negative SYTOX permeability, and WISH expression context without extracting unsupported figure values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.review_closeout: The previous open rework target is closed because the missing activity rows and database reconciliation were repaired from local material; remaining caveats are explicit cautions and do not require another queue ticket.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Merged APD6/DBAASP sequence rows share the β2M N-terminal prefix reported by the paper, but the full mature sequence is database-provided beyond the primary-source prefix; assay values remain table-verified.
Some DBAASP/CAMP rows combine or omit buffer-specific details; final activity records use primary Table 1 buffer-specific locators as the authoritative values.
Local supplementary assets were HTML article/figure landing pages; no recoverable spreadsheet/PDF supplementary activity table was present.
Mechanism figures support direction/assay class from captions and text, but exact pixel-derived fluorescence values were not extracted.

closed_rework_tickets.closure_reason: Worker-2 recovered source-supported activity rows; worker-4 reconciled linked database rows with conflict preservation; worker-6 rewrote final adjudication with source-reviewed cautions.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered the missing Table 1 MIC matrix and reconciled linked database rows. The paper is publication-grade only as accepted_with_cautions: activity values are primary-table supported, while database sequence/context and figure quantification limits remain explicit cautions.
